label: Stable laws and ungrounded totality remain compatible
paraphrase: A stable populated law has an exact universal projection on its own admitted cell but does not admit arbitrary suffixes. One stable trace also belongs to the fully open profile. A purely unconstrained non-deterministic law remains universally true. An inconsistent initial record empties the cell and makes every global law vacuously hold. The existing brute ungrounded totality scope can coexist with stability, while a grounded totality scope can coexist with all-suffix openness, since no bridge connects the independent coordinates.
